components.heading: Stockpiling and temporary fills.
components.text: The minimum standards set out in TMC 17.05.170 shall also apply to stockpiling and temporary fills with the exception that subsections (b) through (d) thereof may be waived by the Director of Public Works upon proper written justification. (Ord. 16432 § 6(5), 3-10-92. Code 1995 § 66-125.)
